##### **Partnership expands Dynamism’s additive manufacturing portfolio into large-format, high-performance polymer production**


**Montréal & Chicago — 9/11/2026 —** AON3D today announced a new reseller partnership with Dynamism, a Chicago-based additive manufacturing provider serving customers across North America and internationally.


The partnership adds AON3D’s Hylo™ Industrial 3D Printer to Dynamism’s portfolio, giving customers a path beyond desktop 3D printing into larger parts, high-performance polymers, and production applications requiring greater strength, heat resistance, and process control.


One of North America’s largest resellers of additive manufacturing solutions, Dynamism serves a broad customer base already using 3D printing for prototyping, tooling, engineering, and production. Hylo extends those capabilities into larger-format tooling, metal-replacement polymer parts, and demanding aerospace and defense applications.


“Hylo has seen strong adoption from manufacturers pushing additive into end-use applications,” said **Randeep Singh, CEO of AON3D** . “Our partnership with Dynamism is an important step in expanding that momentum and making these capabilities available to a much broader manufacturing audience.”


Hylo combines a **650 × 450 × 450 mm build volume, 250 °C actively heated chamber, dual 500 °C extruders, and an open material platform** to support large-format production in engineering and high-performance polymers including PEEK, PEKK, ULTEM™, and fiber-reinforced materials.


Founded in 1997, **Chicago-based Dynamism is one of North America’s largest additive manufacturing distributors.**


“AON3D is a best-in-class 3D printer and a perfect fit for our portfolio. As customers focus on demanding industrial applications,” said **Douglas Krone, CEO of Dynamism** . “Hylo expands what they can produce—enabling larger, more demanding applications in materials with metal-like properties.”


## Dynamism to Showcases Hylo at IMTS 2026


AON3D and Dynamism will launch the partnership at **IMTS 2026** , September 14–19 at McCormick Place in Chicago. Hylo will be on display at **Dynamism**[booth #338391, South Building, Level 3](https://directory.imts.com/8_0/floorplan/?hallID=33&selectedBooth=booth%7E338391&level=3) .


#### **About Dynamism**


Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Chicago, Dynamism provides professional and industrial additive manufacturing technologies, training, and support to customers across North America and internationally.


#### **About AON3D**


Founded in 2015, AON3D is a venture capital-backed, Montreal-based industrial additive manufacturing company. Driving innovation for hundreds of businesses in 25+ countries, ranging from small businesses to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, AON3D’s open material systems make it easy for businesses to create production-grade parts with metal-like performance, where they need them, when they need them.
